headline: Stuart Prince Raises His Standard in the Highlands, Calls Clans to Arms
dispatch: Glenfinnan, Scotland, Aug. 19 -- The young pretender Charles Edward Stuart today raised the royal standard of his father's cause before several hundred armed Highlanders gathered at the head of Loch Shiel. The Earl of Tullibardine unfurled the banner as claymores were drawn and pipes sounded across the glen. The government in London has ordered troops to move north, and the fate of the British throne now hangs on how many clan chiefs answer the prince's call.
answer: Bonnie Prince Charlie raises Jacobite standard, 1745
